name: Omron E5CC digital temperature controller (Modbus)
doc_revision: E5@C Digital Temperature Controllers Communications Manual (H175), PDF keywords 'H175-E1-17 0922'
notes: Uses the Two-byte mode addresses (hex) of the Section 5 variable area list; Modbus function codes 03 (read), 06 and 16 (write). The manual's addresses are protocol addresses (example: PV read at 'Address H2000'), so address_base=0. Four-byte mode addresses (0000, 0004, ...) are not used. Data are signed 16-bit integers in two's complement without decimal point (D'105.0 -> 1050); PV/SP/alarm values are therefore raw (scale depends on sensor/decimal point); MV and heater current have fixed 0.1 resolution per the manual's ranges. Status registers are bit fields defined in the CompoWay/F chapter (not read here). Registers that are not displayed or model dependent (E5EC/E5AC only etc.) are omitted. Communication parameters (unit no. default 1, send wait 20 ms default; baud 9.6/19.2/38.4/57.6 kbit/s) are set on the front panel and are NOT in the variable area; they take effect after controller reset. Table 1-1-6 highlights defaults: 9.6 kbit/s, unit 1, parity Even (highlight read from a page image - please confirm); for Modbus the manual requires 8 data bits and 1 stop bit with Even/Odd parity or 2 stop bits with parity None, hence the connection block (9600, E, 8, 1) is derived from those statements. Writes can be rejected (error 04) when the Communications Writing parameter is OFF, during AT execution, or for protect-level parameters. The heating P/I/D rows were not found in the extracted table and are omitted.

points.name: PV
points.note: Raw integer; scaled by the Decimal Point Monitor (0x2410). Range per sensor.

points.name: Status (low 16 bits)
points.note: Bit layout is in the CompoWay/F section (page 3-23) of the manual; not decoded here.

points.name: Internal Set Point
points.note: Raw integer, scaled by Decimal Point Monitor. SP lower limit to SP upper limit.

points.name: Decimal Point Monitor
points.note: 0..3 = number of decimal places of PV/SP.

points.name: Set Point
points.note: SP lower limit to SP upper limit (parameter-dependent, no fixed min/max). Raw integer scaled by Decimal Point Monitor. Same SP is also at 0x2602 (operation level).

points.name: Manual MV
points.note: Standard control range -5.0..105.0; heating/cooling control allows -105.0..105.0 (min/max here use the standard range).

points.name: Input Digital Filter
points.note: Manual range 0.0 to 999.9 (unit not stated in the extracted table).
